ai.title: Strip markdown code fences from rewritten file response
ai.summary: Updated `process-file-block.ts` to strip markdown code fences from AI responses when the entire content is wrapped in backticks. The prompt explicitly forbids markdown blocks, and a regex fallback removes them if present to ensure clean file writes. This change affects the backend file rewriting logic.

eli5.text: When the assistant rewrites a file, it now automatically removes any surrounding code fences (the triple backtick markers some AI systems wrap around their output) so the saved file contains only the actual content. This affects the backend file rewriting logic and prevents stray markdown artifacts from being written into generated files. You wouldn't directly notice the change unless you inspected the backend logs or watched the file-writing process, since it only cleans up edge cases where the AI response accidentally includes extra formatting.

ai.title: Knowledge file prompt forbids content removal
ai.summary: The knowledge file generation prompt in backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts now explicitly instructs the model not to remove previous content. This change ensures that updates either reproduce the entire file with additions or use SEARCH/REPLACE edits to insert new lines, preserving existing knowledge.

eli5.text: When the system updates its internal notes files, it now must keep all the older notes intact and only add to them, rather than rewriting or removing anything. This applies to anyone who maintains or relies on those notes, and if you looked at an updated notes file you'd see the full previous text still present with new lines added in place. The change is live today.

ai.title: Raise bar for knowledge file generation
ai.summary: Updated prompt in `backend/src/generate-knowledge-files.ts` to require a strong 'yes' on generality, non-derivability, and future relevance before creating or updating knowledge files. This ensures only high-value, non-obvious context is recorded, reducing noise from trivial changes. Scope limited to backend knowledge generation logic.

eli5.text: You don't need to look at the code or know file names to understand this. The system that records important lessons learned now applies a stricter test before writing anything down. Only changes that teach something broadly useful, not obvious from the code itself, and relevant to future work will now make it into the internal knowledge notes. As a result, the recorded notes become much quieter, skipping trivial day-to-day tweaks while still preserving genuinely helpful context.

ai.title: Show session token usage on exit
ai.summary: Added session_credits_used to usage responses and quota checks. Tracks credits consumed during the current WebSocket session via clientSessionId. Updated common/src/actions.ts, common/src/billing/quota-manager.ts, and backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts. Requires passing sessionId to genUsageResponse and checkQuota.

eli5.text: When you close a chat session, you'll now see a number showing how much of your usage came from that specific session, alongside your overall monthly total. The system tracks credits consumed during your current WebSocket connection using a session identifier, and this per-session count is included in the usage data returned when a quota check or exit happens. This lets you see exactly how much you used in the session you just closed, rather than only seeing your running monthly balance.
